about: What Large Fry says at home. The lines are placeholders written on 2026-11-13, not the owners' wording. Format: see scripts/talk_box.gd.

choices.say: Your elevator is out of order. I reported it. Twice.
Nice fish. You got paperwork for those?
Is that a gold record? What for?

lift.speaker: npc
lift.line: I live on the ground floor, playboy. Report the stairs next.

fish.speaker: npc
fish.line: They got better paperwork than you. Don't tap the glass.

gold.speaker: npc
gold.line: For selling records. You should try it sometime.
